description: Women for Ford is about real leadership, not symbolism. I was raised by a strong mother and I am raising a daughter of my own. I understand that women face different challenges at every stage of life, as students, workers, mothers, caregivers, and seniors. My record shows that I have delivered for women before, and in Congress I will fight to protect women’s rights, healthcare, economic security, and dignity with action, accountability, and law. I have stood with women in Illinois, and I am ready to stand with women in Washington.
paid_for_by: Paid for by La Shawn K
title: Women for Ford - A Governing Platform - Ford for Congress
